name: recommended_350yd_params
honesty: No Instagram-derived or Mason-clip data, no video, no imit_private files read for this table. Env numbers come only from the scripted zero-residual scan results/power_loft_scan1_s25.json.
Env distance/carry are in METRES (env reward/penalty code and TrackMan 251 m comparison); yards = m*1.0936. Env has no roll: distance == carry.
Model rows are repo analytic model (NOT a source). Mason's 120+ mph is self-reported, unverified. Nothing here was rolled out in MuJoCo for the recommended loft_deg -28 (interpolated).

measured_loft_scan.note: cliff: launch std 13.7 deg = mixed mishits; carry 235 m; do not use

scan_fit.basis: linear fit of measured points (4 pts); -23 excluded (cliff)

reasons: 7.8 deg would be loft_deg ~-24.3 (fit), beyond the measured -25 (8.30 deg, carry 274 m = -25 m / -8% vs peak) and next to the -23 failure (launch std 13.7 deg, carry 235 m).
Model: 7.5-8.2 deg costs 0..8 yd at best (K=4.0) and 8-16 yd at K=5.6 at 130 mph; model optimum 10-11 deg.
-27 (9.72 deg) measured costs 6.4 m (2%) vs the -29 peak; -28 interpolates ~10.4 deg for ~3 m.
Env spin formula 130*v*sin(launch+2) gives ~2340 rpm at 9.7 deg (a gate JSON backspin of ~2359 was reported by the Trainer, consistent), inside the 1800-3000 gate.

three_fifty_note: 350 yd TOTAL = 320 m. Measured env carry at 132.4 mph is 293-299 m = 320-327 yd carry (no roll). Model total (carry + roll) at 130-132 mph AoA+4 DL 11-12 is 349-361 yd (K=4.0: 349-356, K=5.6: 355-361). 350 yd CARRY (320 m) is ~21-27 m above the best measured env carry and not reached by the model (max ~333 yd): stretch/unverified.

shaping_terms.def_: eps_s = ball start azimuth - target azimuth (deg), from first 5 ms of ball velocity
shaping_terms.anchor: PING 2018: start = 0.76 face + 0.24 path (snippet-verified, unverified full text); model start-line sigma 1.03 deg for pro (face=path=1.29) and 1.39 for Broadie Am1; start sigma 1.0 = pro-level goal; +3 stock ~1.4

shaping_terms.def_: f = club-face yaw (face normal projected on ground) minus target line at first contact (deg)
shaping_terms.anchor: stock +3 face sigma ~1.5 deg (between model rows 1.29 pro / 1.75 Am1; no published face sigma exists); curriculum: start sigma 3.0 anneal to 1.5

shaping_terms.def_: p = club-head velocity azimuth at contact minus target line (deg)
shaping_terms.anchor: same as face; path matters 24% for start line but sets curve via face-to-path
TrackMan: 2 deg F2P ~19 yd curve, 5 deg ~44 yd at 275 yd carry (snippet, unverified); elite keep within ~1 deg

shaping_terms.def_: existing env term: lat_weight*_lat_pen with lat_angular=True (percent of carry, cap 30) so short shots cannot hide a miss; report in yards = metres*1.0936
shaping_terms.anchor: Broadie pro direction sigma 4.0 deg = 7% of carry = ~21 yd at 300 yd; 1 deg ~1.75% ; with carry reward ~24/shot, 1 pro-sigma miss costs ~7
shaping_terms.basis: derived; uses existing env knob (no code change)

shaping_terms.def_: existing elev_target_deg/elev_weight (elev_weight is 0.0 in the loft-27 gate config, so the 12.5 deg default target was NOT active there)
shaping_terms.anchor: model carry optimum 10-11 deg at 130 mph; env scan carry peak at 11.2-12.6 deg

shaping_scale_note: All per-shot terminal terms, summed with the existing carry reward (~24 at carry_cap 120). Weights and sigmas are derived starting points to be tuned, not published values. Cap each squared term at 9 (3 sigma).

dispersion_anchors.env_scripted_lateral_std_m: 1.5-2.5 m (0.3-0.5 deg at 293 m) in the scan: the scripted swing is ~10x tighter than any human reference, so the goal for a learned policy is to stay near it, not to match human scatter
dispersion_anchors.source: docs/LOFT_ENV_PARAMS_AND_DISPERSION.md (Broadie fetched; PING, TrackMan snippets unverified; face/path sigma not published)

logging_needed: Env does not log face yaw, club path, or dynamic loft at contact; add them (read face normal and club-head velocity at first contact) before using face/path terms. env/ is read-only for the Data Agent.

bc_prior_options.note: reference tracking/RSI prior; provenance.py still says commercial_ok=True (open flag for Mason/counsel)
not in repo; general humanoid prior; never commit

bc_prior_options.source: scripted zero-residual swing + residual policy (own code)
bc_prior_options.note: recommended base: measured scatter 2 m; learn residual with shaping terms above

recommended_bc: Use scripted swing as the behaviour prior (own code, no license issue): DAgger/BC-regularise the residual toward zero (small residual_scale) and add the shaping terms; use CMU/MultiSense only as tagged counsel_required tracking references.
unverified_items: face/path sigmas 1.5/1.29 (not published; calibrated or assumed)
step from scripted to learned-policy scatter
env units = metres (code reading; confirm with Trainer)
